params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever {{ci|Kayn}} scores champion {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} or deals damage against champions, he earns orbs that unlocks his {{ci|Rhaast|Darkin Slayer}} and {{ci|Shadow Assassin}} forms. '''Kayn''' can return to the [[Spawn|summoning platform]] to transform, permanently empowering his abilities.
params.blurb4:
[[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} If '''Kayn''' has been [[combat status|out of combat]] for a period, his attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} for a short time upon entering combat.

[[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Bonus:}} '''Rhaast''' {{tip|heals}} for a portion of the damage he deals to enemy champions with his [[champion ability|abilities]].
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kayn''' has a secondary {{tt|experience bar|Additional info in the notes below}} that tracks progress toward his {{ci|Rhaast|Darkin Slayer}} and {{ci|Shadow Assassin}} forms. He gathers orbs from champion {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} and each instance of damage (excluding {{tip|damage over time}}) dealt against champions. Once he has earned enough orbs, he unlocks a form based on whether he earned more from {{tip|melee}} or {{tip|ranged}} champions (for {{ci|Rhaast|Darkin Slayer}} and {{ci|Shadow Assassin}}, respectively), with the other form unlocked later.
params.description2:
While near his team's [[Spawn|summoning platform]], '''Kayn''' {{tt|can choose a form|By clicking on the portrait in the HUD}} to enter transformation over 6 seconds, becoming {{tip|invulnerable}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for the duration. At the end of the transformation he is restored to full {{as|health}} and {{as|mana}}. The transformation will grant a passive bonus and permanently empower some of '''Kayn's''' abilities based on the form chosen. He gains a one-time [[Homeguard]] once the transformation is complete.

'''''Kayn''' cannot activate the transformation while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''
params.description3: [[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} Upon entering [[combat status|combat]] with enemy champions, '''Kayn''' becomes empowered for 3 seconds to deal {{pplevel|key=%|20 to 40}} of {{tt|post-mitigation|Damage calculated after modifiers}} {{as|physical|physical damage}} and {{as|magic|magic damage}} damage dealt against enemy champions as {{tip|magic damage|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}}}. This effect cannot trigger again until '''Kayn''' has been out of combat with champions for over 8 seconds, with the timer being reset if he recasts ''{{ai|Umbral Trespass|Kayn}}''.
params.description4: [[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} '''Rhaast''' {{tip|heals}} for 25% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation|Damage calculated after modifiers}} {{tip|physical damage|{{as|physical damage}}}} that he deals to enemy champions with his {{tip|abilities}}.
params.notes:
* The ''Shadow Assassin Bonus'' will not be triggered nor have its out-of-combat timer be refreshed if '''Kayn''' deals {{tip|true damage|{{as|true damage}}}}. * If the ''Shadow Assassin Bonus'' is granted by '''Kayn''' dealing damage, the triggering instance of damage will benefit from the bonus. * Unlike normal damage modifiers, the ''Shadow Assassin Bonus'' does not inherit [[damage]] tags from the source. {{bug|2}} * Entering transformation will not {{tip|Homing projectile destruction|destroy}} in-flight {{tip|projectile|projectiles}}. ; The Orb System The experience is depicted as orbs that drop upon the ground. {{tip|Melee}} champions drop red orbs that grant progress towards {{ci|Rhaast|Darkin Slayer}}, while {{tip|ranged}} champions drop blue orbs that grant progress for {{ci|Shadow Assassin}}. Orbs will remain on the ground until automatically collected by '''Kayn''' regardless of range once he leaves [[combat status|combat]]. The orbs will be collected even if '''Kayn''' {{tip|death|dies}}. The experience bar above his portrait gauges his current progression, the color reflects the form with greater progress. '''Kayn''' can transform by interacting with his portrait, and can wait 4 minutes until the other form becomes available, reduced by 5 seconds for each collected orb of their type after that. * ''Melee'' orbs grant 2 points per hit and 6 points per takedown. * ''Ranged'' orbs grant 3 points per hit and 7 points per takedown. * The amount of points received per orb is multiplied by {{pp|type=minutes|3;3+(10-3)/8*(x-1) for 6; then + (10-3)/8*x*1.15|0;5 to 13 by 1|formula=Increases each second after 5 minutes. At 10 minutes it increases by 15% more per second until it caps at 13 minutes.}}. * The bar gets filled up completely at 500 points. * If the two forms are within 8% of each other, the last champion range type hit will determine the winner. If both types are hit at the same time, the transformation will default to {{ci|Rhaast|Darkin Slayer}}. * Each side's bar has a bucket system, starting at 60 points. ** Each time an orb is taken the system checks if there's an amount of points in the bucket equal to or higher than the amount received from the orb.
If there is, '''Kayn''' is given an additional orb of the same type he received, while also subtracting that amount of points from the bucket. ** The bucket fills by {{fd|0.8}} points per second if out of champion combat for 70 seconds. * Damage dealt by {{tip|persistent damage|damage over time}} effects and specifically {{ri|First Strike}} and {{ri|Summon Aery}} will not grant orbs. * The following table refers for interactions while '''Kayn''' is transforming: {{ct|attack=false|move=false|cast=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=false|interrupts=false}}
params.flavorsound: {{sm2|Kayn Original Assassin SFX Passive Transform.ogg}}{{ccib|Kayn_OriginalCircle_Shadow_Assassin.png|size=24}} {{sm2|Kayn Original Slayer SFX Passive Transform.ogg}}{{ccib|Kayn_OriginalCircle_Rhaast.png|size=24}} ''Transformation alert.''

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kayn}} {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through. He then swings his scythe, dealing the same damage to surrounding enemies.
params.blurb4: [[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} ''Reaping Slash'' deals damage based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayn''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through. He then swings his scythe, dealing the same damage to nearby enemies.
params.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|75 to 195}} {{as|(+ 85% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|75*2 to 195*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|85*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
params.description2: Both instances of ''Reaping Slash'' deal {{as|40 '''bonus''' physical damage}} against {{tip|minion|minions}} and {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
params.leveling2: {{st|Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|75+40 to 195+40}} {{as|(+ 85% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|(75+40)*2 to (195+40)*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|85*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
params.description3: [[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} ''Reaping Slash's'' damage is modified to deal {{as|65% AD}} {{as|(+ 6% {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|physical damage}} with each hit, for a total of {{as|{{ap|65*2}}% AD}} {{as|(+ {{ap|6*2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|3.5*2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}. This damage has a cap against monsters that does not include the '''bonus''' damage.
params.leveling3: {{st|Capped Monster Damage per Hit|{{ap|200 to 400}}|Total Capped Monster Damage|{{ap|200*2 to 400*2}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Reaping Slash's'' dash speed is increased by '''Kayn's''' {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} will block only a single instance of damage - either the dash or the slash.
* If the {{tip|dash}} is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, '''Kayn''' will not swing his scythe.
* ''Reaping Slash's'' swing can be performed quicker if the dash stops prematurely upon colliding with terrain.
* As the {{ci|Shadow Assassin}}, an [[File:Kayn Reaping Slash A.png|20px|border]] alternate icon for ''Reaping Slash'' is used but has no modified effect.
* Other abilities can be queued while casting ''Reaping Slash''.
* [[Active ability items|Item actives]] are locked out while casting.
* The swing's animation has a {{fd|0.25}}-second {{tip|lockout}} time.<!--The dash + swing takes about 0.66 seconds-->
** '''Kayn''' will only be able to move after {{fd|0.416}} seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kayn}} swings his scythe in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} and briefly {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies hit.
params.blurb4:
[[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} ''Blade's Reach's'' area is extended. '''Kayn''' conjures a shadow to perform ''Blade's Reach'' in his stead, removing the ability's cast time.

[[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} ''Blade's Reach'' briefly {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} enemies hit.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayn''' swings his scythe in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 90% decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.description2: [[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} ''Blade's Reach's'' radius is extended by 200 units. '''Kayn''' conjures an {{tip|untargetable}} ''shadow'' at the casting position to perform ''Blade's Reach's'' sweep over {{fd|0.55}} seconds in his stead, removing the ability's cast time.
params.description3: [[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} ''Blade's Reach'' {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} enemies hit for 1 second.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kayn}} gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|ghosting}} and the ability to enter terrain for a duration. If he has recently been [[combat status|in combat]] with enemy champions, the duration is dramatically reduced.
params.blurb2: '''Kayn''' {{tip|heals}} himself upon entering terrain for the first time from casting ''Shadow Step''. If he receives damage or deals damage against an enemy {{tip|champion}} during ''Shadow Step'', the duration is dramatically reduced.
params.blurb4: [[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} ''Shadow Step'' has a reduced {{sti|cooldown}}. '''Kayn''' gains {{tip|slow resist}} and more {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while in terrain.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayn''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|40% '''bonus total''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|ghosting}} and the ability to ignore terrain collision for a duration. If he has been [[combat status|in combat]] with enemy champions within the last 3 seconds, ''Shadow Step'' will instead last {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.description2: '''Kayn''' {{tip|heals}} himself upon entering terrain for the first time from casting ''Shadow Step'' and he gains {{tip|unobstructed vision}} while inside.
params.description3: Receiving damage from or dealing damage to an enemy {{tip|champion}} while ''Shadow Step'' is active reduces its remaining duration to {{fd|1.5}} seconds. This effect also cannot remain active out of terrain for longer than {{fd|1.5}} seconds and will cancel immediately if '''Kayn''' performs a [[basic attack]] or becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}}.
params.description4: [[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} ''Shadow Step's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced to 10 seconds at all ranks. '''Kayn''' gains 100% {{tip|slow resist}} while active and, upon entering terrain, the {{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}} is increased to {{as|70%|ms}} for the remaining duration.
params.notes:
* As {{ci|Rhaast}}, an [[File:Shadow Step R.png|20px|border]] alternate icon for ''Shadow Step'' is used but has no modified effect.
* The {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} {{tip|stacks multiplicatively}} with other sources of movement speed boosts.
* Self {{tip|immobilize|immobilizations}} such as {{ii|Zhonya's Hourglass}} also count for interrupting ''Shadow Step''.
* {{si|Recall}} is disabled while '''Kayn''' is inside terrain.
* Enemies cannot see '''Kayn''' while he is inside of terrain unless they have terrain-piercing vision, such as {{ai|Heightened Senses|Quinn}}, {{ai|Hawkshot|Ashe}} or {{tip|unobstructed vision}}.
** However, enemies and allies (including '''Kayn''') will be notified when nearby terrain is infested if '''Kayn''' is within 1000 units of an enemy champion - with an indicator being placed on the terrain with a direct line between '''Kayn''' and the enemy champion. ''Slightly less than standard sight radius, but more than the {{tip|camouflage}} detection radius.''
* '''Kayn''' can move up to 550 units beyond the outer-edge of the battlefield.
* ''Shadow Step'' can interact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
* If '''Kayn''' is inside terrain when the effect ends, he will be placed correspondingly to the nearest valid space.
* {{tip|Sleep}} will not interrupt ''Shadow Step''.{{bug}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Kayn}} ''marks'' enemy champions he has damaged for a few seconds.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayn''' {{tip|vanish|vanishes}} and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to a ''marked'' enemy champion. Upon arrival, he {{tip|channel|channels}} for a short time, {{tip|attach|attaching}} to the target and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Kayn''' deals {{as|physical damage}} to the target and {{tip|dash|dashes}} out from their body in the target direction.
params.blurb4:
[[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} ''Umbral Trespass'' has increased range. Emerging will {{sti|cdr|reset}} ''{{ai|The Darkin Scythe A|Kayn|The Darkin Scythe's}}'' cooldown.

[[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} ''Umbral Trespass'' deals damage based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}, and {{tip|heals}} him for a portion of the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kayn''' ''marks'' enemy champions he damaged in the last {{fd|3.15}} seconds.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayn''' {{tip|vanish|vanishes}} and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to a ''marked'' enemy champion over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, {{tip|attach|attaching}} himself to them at the end of the dash. After {{fd|0.5}} seconds of his arrival, he {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 2 seconds, during which the target is {{tip|true sight|revealed}}. ''Umbral Trespass'' can be recast during the channel after {{fd|0.1}} seconds have elapsed, and does so automatically after the duration or if it is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} After a delay of {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds to {{fd|0.75}} seconds|See notes}}, '''Kayn''' deals {{as|physical damage}} to the target and {{tip|dash|dashes}} out from their body in the target direction, detaching himself from them and becoming targetable again at the end of the dash.
params.description4: [[File:Shadow Assassin OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Shadow Assassin Bonus:}} ''Umbral Trespass'' gains 200 '''bonus''' cast range and emerge range. Additionally, emerging will reset ''{{ai|The Darkin Scythe A|Kayn|The Darkin Scythe's}}'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
params.description5: [[File:Rhaast OriginalSquare.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Darkin Slayer Bonus:}} ''Umbral Trespass'' is modified to deal {{as|physical damage}} equal to {{as|15% {{as|(+ 10% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, and also {{tip|heals}} '''Rhaast''' for {{as|{{ap|15*0.75}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|10*0.75}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} after the recast's delay.
params.target range: {{dv|{{tt|550|Standard cast range for Kayn and Darkin Slayer}}|{{tt|750|Enhanced cast range for Shadow Assassin}}}}
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tt|300|Standard recast dash range for Kayn and Darkin Slayer}}|{{tt|300 - 500|Minimum and maximum recast dash range for Shadow Assassin}}}}
params.outofrange: Walk in range of the target unit to cast (first cast)
params.notes:
* ''Umbral Trespass' '' recast delay lasts for an inconsistent period of time.{{bug|1}}
* The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}.
** The recast (both manual and automatic) does not.
** The ability activation happens when '''Kayn''' is attached to his target and the channel starts.
*** {{ci|Kassadin}} cannot reduce {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} cooldown because '''Kayn''' is untargetable during the activation.
* The ability will recast if '''Kayn''' is ordered a movement command.
* '''Kayn''' will reappear from being {{tip|vanish|vanished}} as soon as the recast is cast, while remaining untargetable.
* Upon recast, '''Kayn''' will always damage his target from the east, regardless of the direction he chooses to dash in.
* '''Kayn''' will arrive to the target after {{fd|0.25}} seconds regardless of how far they move away from him during the dash.
* If ''Umbral Trespass'' is targeted on an enemy with a {{tip|spell shield}} or a {{ci|Fiora}} with her {{ai|Riposte|Fiora}} active, the ability will fail to cast entirely, being placed on full cooldown without triggering the active's effects (as well as on-cast effects).
** Spell shield will not block the damage from the recast.
* If the target {{tip|death|dies}}, enters {{tip|resurrection}}, or is sent to the {{ai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser|Death Realm}} while '''Kayn''' is {{tip|attached}}, the channel will be cancelled and he will instantly detach and reappear on top of the target's location. This does not occur if '''Kayn''' is in the process of emerging from the target.
** If those same conditions occur before the attachment, '''Kayn''' will reappear at the target's location at the end of his dash.
** ''Umbral Trespass' '' cooldown will sometimes be refunded at the end of the {{tip|channel}} if any of these conditions occur during it.{{bug|1}}
** If the target is a {{tip|clone}} that expires while '''Kayn''' is attached, ''Umbral Trespass'' will recast automatically.
* If '''Kayn''' dies while {{tip|attached}} and the recast is available, ''Umbral Trespass' '' damage is dealt immediately. If the recast is not available, ''Umbral Trespass' '' damage is not dealt at all.
** Entering {{tip|resurrection}} while {{tip|attached}} does not deal ''Umbral Trespass' '' damage regardless of if the recast is available or not.
*** '''Kayn''' will detach immediately in both cases.
* ''Umbral Trespass' '' interactions with {{tip|crowd control}}:
** All forms of {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} will interrupt the channel.
** Upon being cast, '''Kayn''' is {{tip|cleanse|cleansed}} of {{tip|drowsy|drowsiness}} effects.
** During ''Umbral Trespass'', '''Kayn''' is immune to {{tip|flee|fear}}.
** Despite being a movement channel, ''Umbral Trespass'' is not interrupted by {{tip|root}}.
** {{tip|Root}} will not disable ''Umbral Trespass' '' recast, despite it being a dash.
* As {{ci|Rhaast}}, ''Umbral Trespass'' will grant the {{tip|heal}} automatically if the target dies during the channel.
** The heal is not granted if the target dies before the channel starts.
* '''Kayn''' will draw {{tip|turret}} aggro after the recast's dash, despite the damage being dealt to the enemy while he was untargetable.
* Until the recast or after the duration, the ability will have had no effect on the target for the purposes of {{ri|Electrocute}} or the 'in-combat' status.
* The damage is '''not''' blocked if the target is {{tip|untargetable}} at the time of the recast.
** While ''{{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounting}}'', {{ci|Kled}} blocks the damage of ''Umbral Trespass''.{{bug}}
* ''Umbral Trespass'' cannot be cast on <!--targetable {{tip|zombie state|zombie states}} such as -->{{ci|Sion}} during {{ai|Glory in Death|Sion}}.
* During ''Umbral Trespass'', '''Kayn''' will not take the self-inflicted damage from {{iis|Death's Dance}} {{nie|Ignore Pain}} if the damage was sourced from a {{tip|turret}}.
* '''Kayn''' will copy his target's total [[size]] for ''Umbral Trespass' '' duration, even if their size is smaller than his.
* The player's screen will direct to the target's position upon attaching.
* As {{ci|Rhaast}}, an [[File:Kayn Umbral Trespass R.png|20px|border]] alternate icon is used for the initial activation of ''Umbral Trespass''.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Kayn''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}} and dashing out of the victim:
** The dash out is not interrupted by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.
